description:
Off-Hours Access — WARN0309

Scans the audit log for connections or DML outside business hours from non-exempt accounts. Useful for PCI-DSS and HIPAA compliance auditing.

config_keys.label: Business hours start (0-23)
config_keys.help: Hour of day (local time) from which database activity is considered normal.

config_keys.label: Business hours end (1-24)
config_keys.help: Hour of day (local time) after which database activity is considered off-hours.

config_keys.label: Always-allowed users
config_keys.help: Comma-separated list of accounts never flagged for off-hours access.

config_keys.label: Watched audit operations
config_keys.help: Comma-separated list of audit log operation types to inspect.

config_keys.label: Timeframe (hours)
config_keys.help: Only audit events within this rolling window are inspected.
